summary: Danaher Corporation filed an 8-K to report the issuance of senior notes in four tranches: €500M Floating Rate Notes due 2028, €750M 3.250% Notes due 2030, €750M 3.625% Notes due 2034, and €1B 4.000% Notes due 2038, under an existing shelf registration. The terms disclosed are aggregate principal amounts, interest rates, and maturity dates. No acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation event is involved. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction with no board recommendation, advisor, premium, or structural overlay beyond standard note issuance mechanics. No risk-arb angle exists.
